races.name: Free Bets On attheraces.com Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Tadej
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong form returning from 44-day break, now gelded with proven 6f ability on this surface
runners_data.comment: G3 win last year; encouraging return when 3rd on AW debut (1m); player back down in trip
runners_data.spotlight: Went close in French Group 2 in July and picked up Deauville Group 3 (also 6f, first-time blinkers) the following month; gelded prior to his reappearance and did enough to show he'd trained on when third of four, beaten 3l, on AW debut at Kempton (1m) in February; wore cheekpieces that day and now drops back to sprinting in returning blinkers; firmly in the picture.

runners_data.name: Sirius A
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 182-day layoff but showed excellent form last season including Group 3 placing at this track
runners_data.comment: Very useful as a juvenile; acts on AW and at 6f; big player if ready for this reappearance
runners_data.spotlight: Matched his previous best when neck second (demoted to third) in Group 3 Sirenia at Kempton (6f; Sayidah Hard Spun fifth) in September and took it up a notch when runner-up in warm Listed event at Dundalk (5f, also Polytrack) the following month; ability to act on AW a plus and he's much respected on this return.

runners_data.name: Lady Kodiac
runners_data.note: Prominent racer stepping up significantly in class but proven winner over this distance with recent Polytrack success
runners_data.comment: 2-2 at 6f on AW; the least exposed of these and she's interesting ahead of this comeback
runners_data.spotlight: Made a promising debut on turf (5f) in August and made virtually all when winning her next two starts, both at Chelmsford (Polytrack) over 6f, latterly in October; the least exposed of these and likely we haven't seen the best of her; interesting ahead of this comeback.

runners_data.name: Anthelia
runners_data.note: Another prominent runner off a long break but Group 2 winner as juvenile with strong 6f record on all-weather surfaces
runners_data.comment: Cracking 1st season led to stab at G1 when last seen in October; feared on return/AW debut
runners_data.spotlight: Splendidly tough juvenile filly who got up late to bag the valuable Super Sprint (5f, good) in July and took her form to a new level when gamely landing the Group 3 Dick Poole at Salisbury (6f, soft) in September; couldn't make a dent in Group 1 Cheveley Park on her final start of the term but that's easily excused and she's a fascinating candidate on this reappearance/AW debut.

runners_data.name: Ten Carat Harry
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse just seven days since last run with excellent all-weather record and strong finishing kick over 6f
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who's fit and having a fine spell; latest can be upgraded; might be the answer
runners_data.spotlight: Five-race winning spree came to an end when third in Lingfield Listed race (7f, Polytrack) in February and again filled that position in valuable event at Newcastle (6f, Tapeta) one week ago; that run can be upgraded (had no cover from a fairly strong wind) and he must be considered with fitness assured.

runners_data.name: Chairmanfourtimes
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 182-day break with Listed form over 5f, may need this distance to see out 6f
runners_data.comment: Listed soft-ground win last year; that might be his surface but not ruled out on AW debut
runners_data.spotlight: Consistent at two and his form spiked when winning soft-ground Listed event at Ayr (5f) in September; previously showed he stays 6f and not dismissed on this reappearance/AW debut, albeit easy turf might be more his thing.

runners_data.name: Sayidah Hard Spun
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare off long 216-day break but previous course winner who needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Creditable fifth in 6f AW G3 in September; bit to find but can't be confidently ruled out
runners_data.spotlight: Landed a Kempton novice (6f, Polytrack) on her second start and it was a creditable effort when fifth in Group 3 over that C&D (Sirius A placed third) when last seen in September; that form leaves her with a bit to find but ability to act on AW is a positive and she can't be ruled out confidently.

runners_data.name: Comical Point
runners_data.note: Confirmed front runner wearing tongue-tie returning from 181-day layoff but essential pace angle in weak pace scenario
runners_data.comment: Norfolk fifth who ran well when last seen; respected on return/AW debut; tongue-tie added
runners_data.spotlight: Highly tried as a juvenile and his best run came on second start when fifth of 15 in Royal Ascot's Norfolk (5f, good to firm) in June; back near that level when third in York Listed event (6f, good) when last seen in October and commands respect on this return and AW debut; tongue-tie added.

races.paceDynamic: Comical Point will make the running but faces no early pressure from this field dominated by prominent racers and hold-up horses. Tadej, Sirius A, Lady Kodiac, Anthelia and Chairmanfourtimes will all track behind in a solid group, while Ten Carat Harry and Sayidah Hard Spun are expected to come from further back. The uncontested leader will dictate fractions and likely maintain energy reserves for the final two furlongs. This controlled tempo strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace without expending early energy.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Comical Point gets soft fractions and stays resolute
scenarios.body: The pace-setter will have every chance to control the race and prove hard to peg back in the straight. Front runners and those tracking closest benefit most from this tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes steady and multiple horses challenge simultaneously
scenarios.body: The bunch of prominent racers will converge on Comical Point entering the final furlong creating a cavalry charge finish. Class horses like Tadej and Sirius A can exploit their tactical positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and bunched
scenarios.body: Ten Carat Harry and Sayidah Hard Spun will have room to wind up from the rear with a decisive late surge. The strong finishers can exploit a sprint finish from disadvantageous positions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Comical Point goes too fast early or fades dramatically
scenarios.body: An unlikely scenario where the leader empties out and creates chaos in a blanket finish. Any horse with tactical speed and fitness could capitalize on the leader's demise.

watchPoints.text: Comical Point must be monitored early - if he goes off too fast or gets headed before the home turn, the race dynamic collapses completely
Ten Carat Harry's fitness after just seven days since his last run could be crucial to whether he can produce his usual strong finish
Tadej's response to gelding and return from six-week break will indicate if he can reproduce his French Group race form
The long layoffs for Sirius A, Lady Kodiac, Anthelia and Chairmanfourtimes mean their fitness levels are unknown quantities
Watch Sayidah Hard Spun's early positioning as she needs to be closer than usual given the likely modest pace

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B-D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Mr Macartney
runners_data.comment: 10,000gns February foal;  first ever juvenile runner for promising in-form yard
runners_data.spotlight: 10,000gns February foal; second foal; dam 5f/6f winner (including 2yo/AW; RPR 87), half-sister to winners Dovey Moon (1m) and Rusalka (Italian 7f-8.5f), out of 1m-1m2f winning close relative of HK 6f Group 2 winner Charles The Great; first ever juvenile runner for his promising in-form yard; market check required.

runners_data.name: Thames Waterman
runners_data.comment: 25,000gns yearling; yard can ready one and betting should be helpful
runners_data.spotlight: 25,000gns yearling; late March third foal; brother to 6f winner Rajaking (including 2yo/AW; RPR 88); dam 6f/7f winner (including AW; 77), closely related to 1m4f winner State Sovereignty, out of maiden half-sister to useful 5f-6f winner Jamaican Bolt; yard can ready one and betting should be helpful.

runners_data.name: Magical Life
runners_data.comment: Failed to register an RPR when 40-1 and beaten 57l at Bath (turf) on debut five days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to register an RPR when 40-1 and beaten 57l at Bath (turf) on her debut five days ago.

runners_data.name: Quantum Swift
runners_data.comment: Dam 2yo AW winner; yard already off the mark with its juvenile when landing the Brocklesby
runners_data.spotlight: March second foal; half-sister to Qatari 7f winner Neebrook; dam 6f AW winner (including 2yo; RPR 68), out of 7f winner; yard off the mark with its juvenile when landing the Brocklesby; likely player, especially with market support.

runners_data.name: Jolly Good Fellows
runners_data.comment: 20,000euros yearling; probably the most interesting pedigree of these; betting helpful
runners_data.spotlight: 20,000euros yearling; March sixth foal; half-sister to 7f AW winner Split Passion (RPR 83); dam 5f and 6f (Listed) 2yo winner (RPR 102), out of 6f 2yo winning half-sister to 5.5f 2yo Group 2 winner Ocean Ridge, is granddaughter of 6f 2yo Group 3 winner

runners_data.name: Step To Glory
runners_data.comment: 14-1 but last on his debut in the Brocklesby; switches to AW & should be capable of better
runners_data.spotlight: 15,000gns yearling; February foal by Cotai Glory; dam unraced half-sister to 5f Group 3 winner Hurricane Ivor from a family of sprinters; 14-1 but finished last on his debut in the Brocklesby at Doncaster (5f, good to soft) a fortnight ago; now switches to AW and should be capable of better.

races.name: Download The Racecourse App Raceday Ready Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Caim
runners_data.note: Lead runner returning after 167 days but showed high-class form before layoff and should control this race from the front
runners_data.comment: Won on debut before close second in Listed event; sets high bar on this return/AW debut
runners_data.spotlight: 10-1 when winning Beverley novice (7.4f) impressively in September and handled a rise in grade well when close second in Newbury Listed event (7f, also soft) the following month; latter form has yet to be thoroughly tested but this is a good spot to get her season underway and it's a high bar she sets on this AW debut.

runners_data.name: Estissa
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong C&D form and Oisin Murphy booking, well-suited to track the leader and strike late
runners_data.comment: Built on promising debut to win C&D novice under Oisin Murphy 18 days ago; fine prospect
runners_data.spotlight: Dam was a Group/Grade 1 winner for these connections and this one built on promising debut in December when landing C&D novice under Oisin Murphy 18 days ago; fine prospect who looks sure to go on to better things.

runners_data.name: Royal Poetry
runners_data.note: Another prominent type who has shown consistent effort levels and should be competitive from a forward position

runners_data.name: Veld
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner making debut for new connections but showed abundant inexperience last time and faces positioning disadvantages
runners_data.comment: 66-1 and looked very raw when last on debut one month ago; likely needs more time
runners_data.spotlight: Half-sister to winners Danger Bay (1m1f; RPR 100) and Myna (1m2f AW; 68); dam 1m4f AW winner (86); displayed abundant inexperience when last on her debut at Southwell (1m; 66-1) one month ago; probably needs more time.

runners_data.name: Calypso Bloom
runners_data.note: Unproven 5-year-old with poor form figures and tendency to fade, making her a speculative outsider only
runners_data.comment: Big prices and well held on both starts so far, latterly at Kempton 11 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Big prices and well held on both starts so far, latterly at Kempton (1m3f; 250-1) 11 days ago.

races.paceDynamic: Caim will establish the early lead without pressure in this small field, creating a sustainable tempo over the 1m½f trip. Estissa and Royal Poetry will track from prominent positions, with Veld likely held up at the back and Calypso Bloom's positioning uncertain given her limited experience. The lack of genuine pace pressure should allow the front rank to dictate terms throughout. This moderate gallop heavily favours front runners and prominent racers who can position early and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Caim gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: The returning runner will have every chance to control the race from the front and prove his class advantage over this field. His superior rating and previous Listed form make him hard to peg back in these conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Estissa or Royal Poetry can improve on recent form
scenarios.body: The winner from this position will benefit from tracking the pace before pouncing late, with Estissa's recent C&D success and Murphy's booking looking particularly appealing. Royal Poetry offers each-way value if building on his promising efforts.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and Veld finds significant improvement
scenarios.body: The inexperienced filly would need to show dramatic progress from her debut to overcome positioning disadvantages. Morrison's yard form remains poor making this scenario unlikely despite her breeding.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Outsider Upset
scenarios.trigger: If all fancied runners underperform dramatically
scenarios.body: Calypso Bloom would need a career-best effort by multiple lengths to feature, having shown little ability in two poor runs. Her 5-year-old status against 3-year-olds provides minimal compensation given the form deficit.

watchPoints.text: Caim breaking slowly or showing rust after his 167-day absence, which could undermine his front-running tactics
Estissa getting too keen early given her recent success at this track and potentially compromising her finishing kick
Royal Poetry being squeezed for room if tracking in behind the leaders given the small field dynamics
Veld showing improved settling ability from her debut run when displaying abundant inexperience
Calypso Bloom's positioning early as her running style remains unclear from limited evidence

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Hunky Dory
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with cheekpieces working well last time but tendency to race too freely could undermine stamina reserves
runners_data.comment: Had excuses on stable debut a fortnight ago; contender to step up on that
runners_data.spotlight: Took well to first-time cheekpieces when opening his account in December Southwell handicap; spoiled the follow-up attempt by racing too freely and subsequently left Mick Appleby for 30,000gns; had excuses when fair fifth on stable debut at Chelmsford (also 6f; Supreme King third, Lazzar behind) a fortnight ago and might emerge best of that trio this time.

runners_data.name: An Outlaw's Grace
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer struggling on similar going recently with poor AW record suggesting surface concerns
runners_data.comment: No wins since debut but this is his easiest task since and he's far from dismissed
runners_data.spotlight: Last of seven in Lingfield Class 2 (6f, Polytrack) on reappearance and just mid-division when back on turf at Doncaster (7f) 12 days ago; that took his record to to 0-9 since debut win but this represents his easiest task for a while; due a further 2lb drop but still needs a second look.

runners_data.name: Lazzar
runners_data.note: Front-running style perfectly suited but cheekpieces return after good spell without headgear raises tactical questions
runners_data.comment: Good spell without headgear this winter; below that form in cheekpieces (retained) latest
runners_data.spotlight: Good spell on AW without headgear this winter, winning Lingfield novice and three Polytrack handicaps (all 6f); cheekpieces were back on when below that form at Chelmsford (raced wide) last time and connections are sticking with them; still not discounted.

runners_data.name: Papa Cocktail
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who knows the track well but needs significant luck in running from this style
runners_data.comment: Won over C&D in January and been running respectably since; respected
runners_data.spotlight: Track regular who doubled his tally over C&D when scoring in January and ran respectably in two subsequent starts in this higher grade; sometimes needs luck in the run but he's respected.

runners_data.name: Supreme King
runners_data.note: Strong recent 6f form but winless record at this venue despite multiple attempts is concerning
runners_data.comment: Completed 6f hat-trick when scoring in February; likely remains in form
runners_data.spotlight: 0-8 here but completed a 6f hat-trick when scoring at Kempton (Polytrack; also won on Tapeta) in February; repeatedly denied a run when unlucky fifth next time and latest third (Hunky Dory fifth) was a solid effort a fortnight ago; considered.

runners_data.name: Whenthedealinsdone
runners_data.note: Patient performer returning from 34-day break with solid recent course form providing confidence
runners_data.comment: 2-2 over C&D and he came back to form when second last time; player
runners_data.spotlight: Awarded Lingfield handicap in early 2025 before going 2-2 over this C&D; just four starts since the latest of those wins last March and firmly back on track when edged out at Chelmsford one month ago; 2lb nudge can't be quibbled with and he needs considering.

runners_data.name: Hoodie Hoo
runners_data.note: Prominent racer facing fitness concerns after 158-day absence despite previous course success
runners_data.comment: Won his maiden over C&D just over a year ago; possible he'll do better this term
runners_data.spotlight: Can have an off day but his maiden win came over C&D just over a year ago and he ran well on occasions subsequently; only made the track once as a juvenile so possible he'll do better this term.

runners_data.name: Addarella
runners_data.note: Handy runner who showed marked improvement on stable debut and handles the track conditions well
runners_data.comment: 1312 in 6f handicaps here and those form figures cannot be ignored
runners_data.spotlight: Belied 66-1 odds when second on March's stable debut, taking her form figures in 6f handicaps at this track to 1312; way off that when dropped to 5f here a fortnight later but her C&D record cannot be ignored.

races.paceDynamic: Lazzar is the only confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gate, allowing him to bowl along at his own rhythm without pressure. The prominent runners Hunky Dory, Hoodie Hoo and Addarella will track close behind, while the hold-up contingent of An Outlaw's Grace, Papa Cocktail, Supreme King and Whenthedealinsdone will need to rely on late finishing kicks. With just one pace-setter, Lazzar creates a controlled tempo that should see the race develop into a sprint finish where positioning becomes crucial. This setup clearly favours prominent racers who can stay close to the pace without having to make up significant ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Lazzar Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Lazzar maintains his recent strong AW form and dictates an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: His winter purple patch continues as he gets the perfect trip out front, while Hunky Dory and Addarella benefit from tracking the sensible pace. The hold-up horses find too much to do as the prominent runners dominate.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Hunky Dory or Addarella can improve on the leader approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: One of the tracking pair capitalizes on their tactical position to overhaul a tiring Lazzar, with Supreme King potentially staying on for minor honours. The winner benefits from being close enough to pounce without doing the donkey work.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Rally
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes too strong and Lazzar weakens significantly in the final 100 yards
scenarios.body: Papa Cocktail or Supreme King time their challenges perfectly as the early leaders pay for their exertions. Their patient tactics pay dividends as they sweep past tired horses in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unconventional Winner
scenarios.trigger: If Hoodie Hoo bounces back dramatically from his long layoff or An Outlaw's Grace finds major improvement
scenarios.body: A horse operating at odds with their recent form springs a surprise, either through significant improvement or perfect trip circumstances. The winner defies expectations based on recent evidence.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Lazzar gets headed early as he hasn't shown the ability to win when not controlling the pace throughout
Monitor Hunky Dory's early settling as his tendency to race keenly could see him empty out in the final furlong
Check Hoodie Hoo's early movements for signs of ring rustiness given the extended 158-day layoff
Watch Supreme King for traffic problems given his hold-up style and poor course record suggesting positioning issues
Monitor Papa Cocktail's position entering the home straight as he needs significant luck from his patient tactics

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Divot
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with Oisin Murphy aboard, trainer in excellent form at 1/1 over 14 days, but 162 days since last run creates fitness concerns despite solid course form
runners_data.comment: Maiden but was second over C&D in September; hood on with Murphy booked for this return
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to score but has posted some solid efforts since June, including when second over C&D in September; raced freely when disappointing at Southwell the following month but the added hood might help and Oisin Murphy's booking suggests he's ready for this return.

runners_data.name: Buck Barrow
runners_data.note: Back-of-field runner with poor trainer form (0/12), needs strong pace to be effective but unlikely to get it in this weak gallop scenario
runners_data.comment: Not disgraced on AW debut in November; watch the market on this first start since
runners_data.spotlight: Gained sole win on third start for this yard when staying on at Ffos Las (1m2f, good to soft) in June; some respectable efforts since, including when keeping-on sixth on AW debut at Kempton (1m4f) in November; possibilities if ready for this first start since so watch the market.

runners_data.name: Gemini Man
runners_data.note: Proven course winner who gets 1m4f perfectly, recent form excellent including course success last month, well-weighted at bottom of handicap
runners_data.comment: In form and went close off this sort of mark in last h'cap; one of the more likely ones
runners_data.spotlight: Landed a first AW success when getting up late to bag 9.5f classified here in February; backed that up when second in another course classified over this trip one month ago; went close off this sort of mark when last tackling a Flat handicap (turf) in August and he's one of the more likely ones.

runners_data.name: Rosco Rogers
runners_data.note: Only potential pace angle but typically settles behind leaders, visor back on after poor run, needs to show more urgency from the gates
runners_data.comment: Cheekpieces were working but he bombed out in visor latest; a possible with CPs back on
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden who threatened to get off the mark in both starts when wearing cheekpieces in February; bombed out in a newly fitted visor when apprentice-ridden at Southwell last time but needs a second look with the cheekpieces back on.

runners_data.name: Moon Over The Sea
runners_data.note: Regular course performer but inconsistent form, cheekpieces removed after promising run last time, may be forced into prominent position early
runners_data.comment: Patchy since winning in January; cheekpieces, worn when third last time, are missing
runners_data.spotlight: Patchy form since winning at Southwell (1m3f) in January; first-time cheekpieces did no harm when third over that C&D a fortnight ago but goes without them this time; still can't be discounted.

runners_data.name: Beaune
runners_data.note: Strong recent form with win and two seconds at this trip, mark rising but still competitive, Daniel Muscutt booking is positive stable indicator
runners_data.comment: In good nick over this trip since February; wide draw not ideal but solid claims again
runners_data.spotlight: In good nick since returning from a break, registering a win and two seconds at 1m4f (two classifieds, one handicap) since February; mark is creeping up and wide draw not ideal but he holds solid claims once again.

runners_data.name: Virtual Hug
runners_data.note: Course winner returning from break, disappointed in classified last time despite earlier promise, needs to rediscover winning thread
runners_data.comment: Won this in 2024 and finally scored again on penultime start; others look more solid
runners_data.spotlight: Landed some tidy bets when taking this in 2024 but subsequently went on a barren spell; finally back on the scoresheet last month but disappointed in a classified (also C&D) one week later; had an excuse that day but others look more solid.

runners_data.name: Versatile
runners_data.note: Winless on all-weather surfaces with poor recent form, cheekpieces removed after blown start last time suggests confidence issues
runners_data.comment: Blew the start on stable debut here ten days ago; unconvincing but needs a market check
runners_data.spotlight: 0-11 on AW; nibbled at in the market before blowing the start in 9.5f selling handicap on stable debut here ten days ago; cheekpieces worn that day are dispensed with and he's yet to convince at this trip; still worth a glance at the betting.

runners_data.name: Tiger Beetle
runners_data.note: Veteran finding his level in lower grades, third in course seller last time when blinkered, needs to prove stamina at this longer trip
runners_data.comment: Third (9.5f) in blinkers here ten days ago; might be finding his level; cheekpieces return
runners_data.spotlight: Used to stay this sort of trip; very low-key start for this yard but has gradually found his level and was blinkered when third in 9.5f course selling handicap ten days ago; cheekpieces, previously worn without success, are refitted.

runners_data.name: Everest
runners_data.note: Finally broke maiden status last time with strong staying finish, Gary Moore stable in good form, stepping up in class but proven stayer
runners_data.comment: Off the mark (1m4f) latest; 7yo mare could become a leftfield improver and go in again
runners_data.spotlight: Went into her last race a 14-race maiden but she'd shown bits and bobs across both codes and got off the mark, staying on strongly to land Lingfield classified (1m4f, Polytrack) a fortnight ago; unexposed in this sphere despite her age and could be a leftfield improver; chance.

runners_data.name: Cogital
runners_data.note: Long absence of 194 days major concern despite course experience, 11-year-old veteran who needs everything to fall right
runners_data.comment: Step back in the right direction over hurdles latest and Probert was aboard for last win
runners_data.spotlight: Won a weak four-runner handicap at Ffos Las (1m6f, good) under David Probert in July but mostly poor form under both codes since; appeared to take a step back in the right direction when second over hurdles last time and Probert is back in the saddle for the first time since that win.

runners_data.name: Late Claim
runners_data.note: Consistent performer with multiple course placings, 7lb claiming apprentice nullifies recent good form, wheels came off in latest starts
runners_data.comment: Wheels have come off lately and new cheekpieces need to get her back on track
runners_data.spotlight: Made successful handicap debut at Lingfield (1m5f, Polytrack) in December and finished runner-up three times since, including over C&D; wheels have come off lately, however, and first-time cheekpieces need to get her firmly back on track.

races.paceDynamic: This race lacks natural pace with all 12 runners showing hold-up tendencies, creating an extremely weak gallop scenario. Rosco Rogers is the only horse with any front-running inclination but typically settles behind the leaders, meaning someone like Moon Over The Sea or Beaune may be forced forward early to avoid getting caught in traffic. The crawling pace will inevitably produce a sprint finish where positioning and a clear run become crucial. This tactical setup strongly favours horses with proven finishing kicks who can secure good positions turning for home, giving hold-up specialists with pace reserves a significant advantage.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses as expected with no genuine leader emerging early
scenarios.body: The field will bunch up through the middle stages before exploding into a frantic sprint finish over the final 2-3 furlongs. Horses with proven turn of foot who can secure clear runs will dominate, while those needing stronger gallops will struggle to show their true ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Positioning Battle
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses push forward simultaneously to avoid the back of the field
scenarios.body: A moderate pace develops as several runners jostle for prominent positions, creating a more honest gallop. This scenario benefits horses who can travel kindly in midfield before finishing strongly, rather than those needing to come from last to first.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Takes Control
scenarios.trigger: If Rosco Rogers or another runner goes forward and dictates from the front
scenarios.body: An uncontested leader steals a march on the field, opening up dangerous gaps on the home turn. Late closers will find the task insurmountable as the leader kicks clear, favouring any horse brave enough to track the pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Stayers Test
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is so slow it becomes a true stamina examination
scenarios.body: The race becomes a war of attrition over the final half-mile with genuine stayers coming to the fore. Horses with proven staying power and strong finishes over extended trips will thrive, while speed horses fade badly.

watchPoints.text: Gemini Man holds a significant class edge as a proven course winner dropping to bottom weight with strong recent form
Watch the early pace development closely as Rosco Rogers may not go forward, leaving the field with no natural leader
Moon Over The Sea could be forced into an uncharacteristic prominent role if nobody else wants the lead
Late Claim's recent poor form combined with apprentice jockey suggests stable confidence has dropped significantly
Divot's long absence of 162 days needs monitoring despite Murphy's booking and trainer's perfect recent record

races.name: Hotel And Conferencing Wolverhampton Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Thapa Vc
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning after 115 days off with mixed recent form but four-time course winner has the tactical edge

races.paceDynamic: Harbour Vision is the only confirmed front-runner in this 12-runner field, meaning he can dictate terms uncontested through the early stages. With Bad Habits, Amelia's Joy, and Tilani sitting prominent, the pace will be genuine but not suicidal as there's no early speed battle. The lack of pace pressure suits hold-up horses who can pick off tired leaders, while prominent runners need to stay close enough to capitalize if the pace becomes too steady. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as the singular leader creates an ideal stalking scenario.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Harbour Vision sets steady fractions without early pressure
scenarios.body: The lone leader creates perfect stalking conditions for closers who can time their run perfectly in the straight. Multiple hold-up horses get ideal positioning to unleash finishing kicks at tired pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Bad Habits or Amelia's Joy track the leader closely and kick early
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get first jump on the hold-up horses by launching their bid before the final furlong. Recent course form and tactical positioning overcome the late closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Harbour Vision finds improved form and maintains his kick
scenarios.body: The 11-time course winner uses track knowledge and uncontested lead to fend off late challengers. His three wins since December suggest he retains enough ability when right.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Harbour Vision goes too slow and prominent horses fail to press
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from halfway with hold-up horses getting perfect conditions. The lack of early pace creates a bunched finish favoring the strongest finishers.

watchPoints.text: Harbour Vision's early pace will determine the entire race outcome as the sole leader in a 12-runner field
Bad Habits and Amelia's Joy must track close enough to the leader without getting trapped behind horses in the straight
Split Elevens and Fistral Beach have the best course records among the hold-up horses and could benefit from perfect positioning
Tilani returns after 171 days off for new trainer Ian Williams and could be overpriced if retaining Galway festival form
Present Times and Harbour Vision both show fading tendencies that make them vulnerable in the final furlong

races.paceDynamic: Calling A Star is the sole confirmed front runner and will likely lead uncontested from the gates, setting a comfortable pace without pressure. The prominent runners Pints In Peace, Tactical Blitz, Dublin Bay, Orange Emperor and Born A Star will settle behind in a cluster, while only Deluded represents hold-up tactics from the rear. With one leader and multiple prominent types tracking, this creates a moderate pace that builds gradually. This race shape clearly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and strike late, as they avoid the risks of being too far back or setting the pace alone.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Strike Late
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent pack tracks Calling A Star in a comfortable rhythm through halfway
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows trackers to conserve energy and multiple horses can challenge simultaneously in the final furlong. Tactical Blitz and Pints In Peace are perfectly positioned to exploit this scenario with their improving profiles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If Calling A Star gets an easy lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Her previous front-running victory here gives her the template to repeat, and the 2lb penalty may not stop her if she gets first run on the field. The prominent horses behind may leave their challenges too late.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly steady and Deluded gets the perfect setup from the rear
scenarios.body: The sole hold-up runner benefits from a crawling pace that becomes a sprint, allowing him to use his finishing kick. However, this requires the prominent pack to go too slowly early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Calling A Star goes too fast early or the prominent horses press her harder than expected
scenarios.body: A genuine pace scenario unfolds where the early speed horses weaken and it becomes a messy finish between the survivors. This favours horses with stamina reserves over pure speed.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Calling A Star gets pressed early by Dublin Bay or Orange Emperor, as she may not have the same easy lead as her maiden win
Monitor Pints In Peace for any signs of his quick reappearance after just 9 days affecting his usual prominent style
Observe if Deluded shows early pace from his wide draw, as any positional change could indicate improved tactics
Check if Tactical Blitz can reproduce his Tapeta form on this surface, as his only turf experience resulted in a poor sixth
Watch for market support behind Orange Emperor given his low weight and recent improvement since gelding

races.paceDynamic: Let Her Go will be the sole early leader with Three Socks On and Adba sitting prominent, creating a moderate but sustainable gallop over this 1m1½f trip. With most runners preferring to come from off the pace (Always A Saint, Rajbello, Al Amirah, Smoker Bellamy, Just Call Me Mo, Make It Up), there will be minimal early pressure on Let Her Go. The race will develop into a classic staying test where the pace will gradually increase from the home turn as the hold-up horses fan wide looking for racing room. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runners and early leaders who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably affect the large contingent of hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Let Her Go and Three Socks On maintain their forward positions without being pressured early
scenarios.body: The lack of pace pressure allows both to conserve energy for a sustained drive, with Three Socks On's recent winning form and slight weight advantage proving decisive. The hold-up brigade gets caught in traffic as the field bunches turning for home.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Always A Saint gets the strong pace and clean run his style demands
scenarios.body: The half-brother to Limato finally shows his breeding with Charlie Fellowes' patient approach paying off after 114 days off. His hold-up style works perfectly if the prominent horses go too hard too early.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Let Her Go and Three Socks On engage in an early speed duel
scenarios.body: Their battle creates the perfect setup for a closer like Adba or Al Amirah to sweep past in the final furlong. Ralph Beckett's filly benefits most from the increased trip and chaotic pace.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the track plays particularly favourably to hold-up horses with experience
scenarios.body: Smoker Bellamy or Rajbello capitalizes on their previous course experience and the 242-day/114-day breaks prove beneficial rather than detrimental. The form horses disappoint in a muddling affair.

watchPoints.text: Three Socks On's tendency to fade in the finish could be crucial if Let Her Go sets a strong gallop from the front
Always A Saint needs to be produced with a well-timed run given his hold-up style and the likely lack of early pace
Let Her Go's ability to sustain her gallop over this extended trip after disappointing last time at Chelmsford
The large number of hold-up horses could create significant traffic problems turning for home
Smoker Bellamy and Always A Saint both return after lengthy breaks which could either hinder or help their chances
